extra_trails.name: Silver Glade
extra_trails.why: Telluride 2024-25 trail map (skimap.org 45884): glade on the north side of the Apex lift (Lift 6) down to its base; placed from 8 control points (lift ends, run tops; median leave-one-out error 120 m) and kept 25 to 35 m off the lift line. Glade: approximate (about 100 m)
extra_trails.fitted: terrain: never climbs, moved 1 m on average

extra_trails.name: Giant Steps
extra_trails.why: Telluride 2024-25 trail map (skimap.org 45884): drawn right beside the Apex lift (Lift 6) down to its base; placed from 8 control points (median leave-one-out error 120 m), then moved onto the open strip in the 1 m canopy height map (Meta/WRI): the lift-line clearing (tree cover 4%, 30% before), moved 22 m on average

extra_trails.name: Chongos
extra_trails.why: Telluride 2024-25 trail map (skimap.org 45884): leaves the Apex lift line near the top of Silver Glade and Giant Steps and runs across toward Happy Thought; placed from 8 control points (median leave-one-out error 120 m). The canopy map shows no clear strip (13% tree cover on the best line), so the trail-map line is kept: approximate (about 120 m)

extra_trails.name: Buzz's Glade
extra_trails.why: Telluride 2024-25 trail map (skimap.org 45884): glade from See Forever down between Happy Thought and Electra toward Bon Vivant; placed from 8 control points (median leave-one-out error 120 m). Glade: approximate (about 100 m)

extra_trails.name: Stormin' Norman
extra_trails.why: Telluride 2024-25 trail map (skimap.org 45884): from Bon Vivant down between Ophir Loop and Dew Drop; placed from 8 control points (median error 120 m), then moved onto the open strip in the 1 m canopy height map (Meta/WRI) not taken by another run: tree cover 0% (24% before), moved 35 m on average
